title: Introductory example 1: campus art-print stall
label: ex:intro-one
trial: one of four pre-booked campus-market sales slots
success: attendance in that slot meets its fixed target
failure: attendance in that slot falls below its target
context: A student books all four sales slots before the weekend. Compare a small print batch with a large batch; both can serve every slot without stock shortages.

title: Introductory example 2: freelance livestream work
label: ex:intro-two
trial: one of three scheduled livestream sessions
success: a home-internet disruption occurs during that session
failure: no home-internet disruption occurs during that session
context: A freelancer commits to three paid sessions before the day begins. Compare home internet alone with mobile-data backup. Count home-internet disruptions even when backup limits their financial effect.

title: Campus sticker sales for one weekend
label: prob:c4-inventory
trial: one of four pre-booked campus-market sales slots
success: attendance in that slot meets its fixed target
failure: attendance in that slot falls below its target
context: A student books four sales slots in advance. Compare a basic sticker pack with a premium pack obtained more cheaply per sticker through a shared bulk order. Each plan can serve every slot.

title: Campus fair or online CV workshop
label: prob:c4-coffee
trial: one of four separately organized campus careers fairs scheduled that day
context: A graduate chooses a plan covering four separately organized fairs: portrait sessions for their customers, or an online CV workshop for the same four student groups. Each fair that goes ahead brings portrait business but draws one group away from the workshop.

title: Freelance digital projects for one month
label: prob:c4-energy
trial: one of four client enquiries fixed at the start of the month
success: that enquiry confirms a paid project by month end
failure: that enquiry does not confirm a project by month end
context: A freelancer follows the same four enquiries under either hypothetical service plan: social-media graphics or short video edits. Assume confirmation depends on the client budget decision and has the same probability under either plan; capacity suffices for all four.

title: Graduation photography for one quarter
label: prob:c4-manufacturing
trial: one of three separately organized graduation ceremonies booked in advance
context: A graduate reserves three photography bookings for the quarter. Compare a basic photo package with an edited package, using the same ceremony outcomes and advance preparation costs.

title: Campus concert: three venue choices
label: prob:fees
trial: one of five preselected campus ticket-sales groups
success: that group reaches its fixed ticket-sales target by the evening
failure: that group falls below its target
context: A student group chooses a small hired room, a discounted student-union room or a large hired room for the same concert. Tickets are sold in five fixed group allotments; all venues can accommodate all allotments. Extra net receipts arise from each group reaching its target.

title: Student fitness sessions: three break-even thresholds
label: prob:defects
trial: one of four preselected campus fitness-interest groups
success: that group reaches its fixed enrollment target by the registration deadline
failure: that group falls below its target
context: A student plans walking, dance or circuit sessions for the same four groups. All formats have capacity for all groups. Use the same enrollment responses for every hypothetical format, with different fixed preparation costs and receipts per successful group.
